subject: general
question: 'A Nation in Making' a book written by ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surendranath Banerjee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"A nation in making" **was a book written by **Surendranath Banerjee** in his last days-1925.
 
• It is the autobiography of one of the earliest political leaders of **British rule**. 
 
• **Surendranath Banerjee** often known as Rashtraguru.
 
• He was Indian nationalist leader during the British Rule.
 
• He founded a nationalist organization called the India National Association and was one of the founding members of the Indian National Congress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gopal Krishna Gokhale** was an Indian 'moderate' political leader and a social reformer during the Indian independence movement. Gokhale was a senior leader of the Indian National Congress and the founder of the Servants of India Society.
 
• **Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel**, commonly known as Sardar, was an Indian lawyer, influential political leader, barrister and statesman who served as the first Deputy Prime Minister of India and first Home Minister of India from 1947 to 1950. He is also called the "Unifier of India".
 
• **Rao Bahadur Mahadev Govind Ranade**, popularly referred to as Justice Ranade, was an Indian scholar, social reformer, judge and author. He was one of the founding members of the Indian National Congress party and owned several designations as member of the Bombay legislative council, member of the finance committee at the centre, and judge of the Bombay High Court, Maharashtra.
